entry.author: ACC New Zealand
entry.summary:
The life of Troy Hall changed dramatically when he was nearly fatally electrocuted on an orchard. Now he’s keen to urge New Zealanders to live in the present, and to always prioritise safety and wellbeing.
 
Read more of Troy’s story on our Newsroom: Troy’s story: https://www.acc.co.nz/newsroom/stories/troys-story-the-second-strike-brought-me-back-to-life


SUBSCRIBE for more ACC New Zealand stories ▶ https://www.youtube.com/c/accnz/

If you're injured in an accident in New Zealand, whether it's relatively minor or something more serious, we're here to give you care and support so you can get back to everyday life.
